title: Happy path - Create a new event with all valid dummy fields and verify it appears in the listing
preconditions: Valid demo credentials from testD.config.json (ginni@gmail.com / Garima@1234567890)
User is authenticated and the Events tab is open
User has fewer than 6 existing events so the new event can be created without auto-replacement

testSteps.action: Navigate to /login and sign in with the demo credentials
Click the Events tab in the top nav
Click 'Add New Event' to open the Add Event form
Enter the dummy event title into the title input
Enter the dummy description into the description textarea
testSteps.testData: Description: 'This is a dummy description for automated test case data.'

testSteps.action: Select the dummy category from the dropdown
Enter the dummy city into the city input
Enter the dummy venue into the venue input
Pick the dummy event date from the date picker
Enter the dummy price into the price input
Enter the dummy seat count into the seats input
Wait for the success toast 'Event created!' to appear
Verify the new event appears in the events listing
testSteps.testData: Expected visible title 'Acme Test Concert 2026' inside an <article> card

dummyValues.title: Acme Test Concert 2026
dummyValues.description: This is a dummy description for automated test case data.

expectedResult: Event is created successfully. The 'Event created!' toast appears, the Add Event form closes or resets, and a new <article> card with the title 'Acme Test Concert 2026' is visible in the events listing showing category 'Concert', city 'Dummyville', venue 'Dummy Arena', date 2027-06-15, price 49.99 and 100 seats.
